name: The vision
description: A vision of a kitten hiding the cream, corvidae and gold in the water, with halos everywhere, seen by seers across New Capenna but not by Raffine.

description_citations.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.
